full_name: 25-item National Eye Institute Visual Function Questionnaire
domains: 12 subscales: general health, general vision, ocular pain, near activities, distance activities, social functioning, mental health, role difficulties, dependency, driving, color vision, peripheral vision
response_scale: difficulty ratings of visual symptoms or day-to-day activities (scale points NR)
scoring: subscales 0-100 (100 = best function); composite = unweighted average of all items excluding general health and ocular pain; driving not scored here (no licence holders)
target_population: NR in this paper (patients with Stargardt disease in this study)
notes: Cronbach alpha 0.93 across subscale scores (p4); no time to administer reported; item-level wording not given; exploratory factor analysis suggested a single dimension (abstract p1)
